Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
A couple of cards have simply been reworded so you can't target "yourself"
or "your own minion" to cycle the card for no effect.

For example:
Dramatic Upheaval: Change places with another Methuselah (not with yourself).

But is it still legal to call Kindred Restructure and keep the same
seating order as the terms of the referendum? (or the ever-popular loophole
where everyone shifts over one seat)
